title: Pan-Seared Fish with Zesty Crisp
description: A classic French dish featuring a delicate fish fillet seared to perfection and served with a zesty and crisp accompaniment.

ingredients.name: Zesty marinade
ingredients.notes: Mix of lemon juice, garlic, and herbs

ingredients.name: Crisp vegetable slaw
ingredients.notes: Shredded cabbage and carrot with zesty dressing

instructions: Preheat your skillet to medium-high heat.
Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper on both sides.
Add a tablespoon of olive oil to the preheated skillet and sear the fish for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Transfer the fish to a plate and let it rest for a few minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a little olive oil in the skillet and add the zesty marinade for 1 minute.
Add a slice of Polish rye bread to the skillet and toast for 1-2 minutes.
Assemble the dish by placing the fish on top of the toasted bread, followed by a spoonful of crisp vegetable slaw.
